mapper.select: select count(*) from warehouse where status != 'DISABLED'
select count(*) from grain_temp_summary

select count(*) from grain_temp_summary s join ( select warehouse_id, max(collected_at) as latest_collected_at from grain_temp_summary group by warehouse_id ) latest_summary on latest_summary.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id and latest_summary.latest_collected_at = s.collected_at where s.warning_flag = 1

select count(*) from prediction_result pr join ( select warehouse_id, max(id) as latest_task_id from prediction_task group by warehouse_id ) latest_task on latest_task.latest_task_id = pr.task_id where pr.phase_type = 'FUTURE' and pr.warning_flag = 1
select count(*) from prediction_task

select concat(w.warehouse_name, ' 实时粮温预警') as title, s.warning_level as level, 'REAL' as sourceType, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, date_format(s.collected_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as eventTime, coalesce( s.warning_message, concat('整仓均温 ', s.avg_temp, '°C，最高温 ', s.max_temp, '°C') ) as description from grain_temp_summary s join warehouse w on s.warehouse_id = w.id join ( select warehouse_id, max(collected_at) as latest_collected_at from grain_temp_summary group by warehouse_id ) latest_summary on latest_summary.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id and latest_summary.latest_collected_at = s.collected_at where s.warning_flag = 1 order by s.collected_at desc, s.max_temp desc limit 4

select concat(w.warehouse_name, ' 预测高温预警') as title, pr.warning_level as level, 'PREDICTION' as sourceType, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, date_format(pr.result_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as eventTime, coalesce( pr.warning_message, concat('预测值 ', pr.predicted_value, '°C') ) as description from prediction_result pr join prediction_task pt on pt.id = pr.task_id join warehouse w on pt.warehouse_id = w.id join ( select warehouse_id, max(id) as latest_task_id from prediction_task group by warehouse_id ) latest_task on latest_task.latest_task_id = pt.id where pr.phase_type = 'FUTURE' and pr.warning_flag = 1 order by pr.result_time desc, pr.predicted_value desc limit 4

select s.id as id, s.warehouse_id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, s.avg_temp as avgTemp, s.max_temp as maxTemp, s.min_temp as minTemp, date_format(s.collected_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as collectedAt, s.warning_level as warningLevel, s.warning_flag as warningFlag, s.warning_message as warningMessage from grain_temp_summary s join warehouse w on s.warehouse_id = w.id join ( select warehouse_id, max(collected_at) as latest_collected_at from grain_temp_summary group by warehouse_id ) latest_summary on latest_summary.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id and latest_summary.latest_collected_at = s.collected_at order by s.warning_flag desc, s.collected_at desc, s.max_temp desc limit 6

select w.id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, case when w.status = 'MAINTENANCE' then 72 when greatest(ifnull(real_warning.level_score, 1), ifnull(prediction_warning.level_score, 1)) = 3 then 68 when greatest(ifnull(real_warning.level_score, 1), ifnull(prediction_warning.level_score, 1)) = 2 then 84 else 96 end as healthScore, case when w.status = 'MAINTENANCE' then 'MAINTENANCE' when greatest(ifnull(real_warning.level_score, 1), ifnull(prediction_warning.level_score, 1)) = 3 then 'WARNING' when greatest(ifnull(real_warning.level_score, 1), ifnull(prediction_warning.level_score, 1)) = 2 then 'ATTENTION' else 'NORMAL' end as riskLevel, case ifnull(real_warning.level_score, 1) when 3 then 'WARNING' when 2 then 'ATTENTION' else 'NORMAL' end as realWarningLevel, case ifnull(prediction_warning.level_score, 1) when 3 then 'WARNING' when 2 then 'ATTENTION' else 'NORMAL' end as predictionWarningLevel, real_warning.latest_avg_temp as latestAvgTemp, prediction_warning.latest_forecast_value as latestForecastValue from warehouse w left join ( select s.warehouse_id, case s.warning_level when 'WARNING' then 3 when 'ATTENTION' then 2 else 1 end as level_score, s.avg_temp as latest_avg_temp from grain_temp_summary s join ( select warehouse_id, max(collected_at) as latest_collected_at from grain_temp_summary group by warehouse_id ) latest_summary on latest_summary.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id and latest_summary.latest_collected_at = s.collected_at ) real_warning on real_warning.warehouse_id = w.id left join ( select pt.warehouse_id, max(case pr.warning_level when 'WARNING' then 3 when 'ATTENTION' then 2 else 1 end) as level_score, max(pr.predicted_value) as latest_forecast_value from prediction_task pt join ( select warehouse_id, max(id) as latest_task_id from prediction_task group by warehouse_id ) latest_task on latest_task.latest_task_id = pt.id left join prediction_result pr on pr.task_id = pt.id and pr.phase_type = 'FUTURE' group by pt.warehouse_id ) prediction_warning on prediction_warning.warehouse_id = w.id where w.status != 'DISABLED' order by healthScore asc, w.id asc limit 6
select count(*) from warehouse w where w.status != 'DISABLED'
select count(*) from grain_temp_summary s join warehouse w on w.id = s.warehouse_id where w.status != 'DISABLED'
select count(*) from grain_temp_summary s join warehouse w on w.id = s.warehouse_id where w.status != 'DISABLED' and s.warning_flag = 1

select count(*) from prediction_result pr join prediction_task pt on pt.id = pr.task_id join warehouse w on w.id = pt.warehouse_id where w.status != 'DISABLED' and pr.phase_type = 'FUTURE' and pr.warning_flag = 1
select count(*) from prediction_task pt join warehouse w on w.id = pt.warehouse_id where w.status != 'DISABLED'

select concat(w.warehouse_name, ' 实时粮温预警') as title, s.warning_level as level, 'REAL' as sourceType, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, date_format(s.collected_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as eventTime, coalesce( s.warning_message, concat('整仓均温 ', round(s.avg_temp, 2), '°C，最高温 ', round(s.max_temp, 2), '°C') ) as description from grain_temp_summary s join warehouse w on w.id = s.warehouse_id where w.status != 'DISABLED' and s.warning_flag = 1
order by s.collected_at desc, s.id desc limit 6

select concat(w.warehouse_name, ' 预测高温预警') as title, pr.warning_level as level, 'PREDICTION' as sourceType, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, date_format(pr.result_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as eventTime, coalesce( pr.warning_message, concat('预测值 ', round(pr.predicted_value, 2), '°C') ) as description from prediction_result pr join prediction_task pt on pt.id = pr.task_id join warehouse w on w.id = pt.warehouse_id where w.status != 'DISABLED' and pr.phase_type = 'FUTURE' and pr.warning_flag = 1
order by pr.result_time desc, pr.id desc limit 6

select s.id as id, s.warehouse_id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, s.avg_temp as avgTemp, s.max_temp as maxTemp, s.min_temp as minTemp, date_format(s.collected_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as collectedAt, s.warning_level as warningLevel, s.warning_flag as warningFlag, s.warning_message as warningMessage from grain_temp_summary s join warehouse w on w.id = s.warehouse_id join ( select s2.warehouse_id, max(s2.collected_at) as latest_collected_at from grain_temp_summary s2 join warehouse w2 on w2.id = s2.warehouse_id where w2.status != 'DISABLED'
group by s2.warehouse_id ) latest_summary on latest_summary.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id and latest_summary.latest_collected_at = s.collected_at where w.status != 'DISABLED'
order by s.warning_flag desc, s.collected_at desc, s.max_temp desc limit 6

select w.id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, case when w.status = 'MAINTENANCE' then 72 when greatest(ifnull(real_warning.level_score, 1), ifnull(prediction_warning.level_score, 1)) = 3 then 68 when greatest(ifnull(real_warning.level_score, 1), ifnull(prediction_warning.level_score, 1)) = 2 then 84 else 96 end as healthScore, case when w.status = 'MAINTENANCE' then 'MAINTENANCE' when greatest(ifnull(real_warning.level_score, 1), ifnull(prediction_warning.level_score, 1)) = 3 then 'WARNING' when greatest(ifnull(real_warning.level_score, 1), ifnull(prediction_warning.level_score, 1)) = 2 then 'ATTENTION' else 'NORMAL' end as riskLevel, case ifnull(real_warning.level_score, 1) when 3 then 'WARNING' when 2 then 'ATTENTION' else 'NORMAL' end as realWarningLevel, case ifnull(prediction_warning.level_score, 1) when 3 then 'WARNING' when 2 then 'ATTENTION' else 'NORMAL' end as predictionWarningLevel, real_warning.latest_avg_temp as latestAvgTemp, prediction_warning.latest_forecast_value as latestForecastValue from warehouse w left join ( select latest_real.warehouse_id, case latest_real.warning_level when 'WARNING' then 3 when 'ATTENTION' then 2 else 1 end as level_score, latest_real.avg_temp as latest_avg_temp from grain_temp_summary latest_real join ( select s2.warehouse_id, max(s2.collected_at) as latest_collected_at from grain_temp_summary s2 join warehouse w2 on w2.id = s2.warehouse_id where w2.status != 'DISABLED'
group by s2.warehouse_id ) latest_summary on latest_summary.warehouse_id = latest_real.warehouse_id and latest_summary.latest_collected_at = latest_real.collected_at ) real_warning on real_warning.warehouse_id = w.id left join ( select pt.warehouse_id, max(case pr.warning_level when 'WARNING' then 3 when 'ATTENTION' then 2 else 1 end) as level_score, max(pr.predicted_value) as latest_forecast_value from prediction_task pt join warehouse w3 on w3.id = pt.warehouse_id left join prediction_result pr on pr.task_id = pt.id and pr.phase_type = 'FUTURE' where w3.status != 'DISABLED'
group by pt.warehouse_id ) prediction_warning on prediction_warning.warehouse_id = w.id where w.status != 'DISABLED'
order by healthScore asc, w.id asc limit 6

select date_format(data.collected_at, '%m-%d %H:%i') as timeLabel, data.avg_temp as primaryValue, data.max_temp as secondaryValue, null as realAlertCount, null as predictionAlertCount from ( select s.collected_at, round(s.avg_temp, 2) as avg_temp, round(s.max_temp, 2) as max_temp from grain_temp_summary s join warehouse w on w.id = s.warehouse_id where w.status != 'DISABLED'
order by s.collected_at desc, s.id desc limit 12 ) data order by data.collected_at asc

select date_format(data.bucket_time, '%m-%d') as timeLabel, null as primaryValue, null as secondaryValue, data.real_alert_count as realAlertCount, data.prediction_alert_count as predictionAlertCount from ( select merged.bucket_time, sum(merged.real_alert_count) as real_alert_count, sum(merged.prediction_alert_count) as prediction_alert_count from ( select date(s.collected_at) as bucket_time, count(*) as real_alert_count, 0 as prediction_alert_count from grain_temp_summary s join warehouse w on w.id = s.warehouse_id where w.status != 'DISABLED' and s.warning_flag = 1
group by date(s.collected_at)
union all
select date(pr.result_time) as bucket_time, 0 as real_alert_count, count(*) as prediction_alert_count from prediction_result pr join prediction_task pt on pt.id = pr.task_id join warehouse w on w.id = pt.warehouse_id where w.status != 'DISABLED' and pr.phase_type = 'FUTURE' and pr.warning_flag = 1
group by date(pr.result_time) ) merged group by merged.bucket_time order by merged.bucket_time desc limit 10 ) data order by data.bucket_time asc

select date_format(data.bucket_time, '%m-%d') as timeLabel, data.task_count as primaryValue, data.warning_count as secondaryValue, null as realAlertCount, null as predictionAlertCount from ( select date(pt.requested_at) as bucket_time, count(distinct pt.id) as task_count, count(distinct case when pr.warning_flag = 1 and pr.phase_type = 'FUTURE' then pr.id end) as warning_count from prediction_task pt join warehouse w on w.id = pt.warehouse_id left join prediction_result pr on pr.task_id = pt.id and pr.phase_type = 'FUTURE' where w.status != 'DISABLED'
group by date(pt.requested_at) order by date(pt.requested_at) desc limit 10 ) data order by data.bucket_time asc

select w.id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, case when w.status = 'MAINTENANCE' then 72 when greatest(ifnull(real_warning.level_score, 1), ifnull(prediction_warning.level_score, 1)) = 3 then 68 when greatest(ifnull(real_warning.level_score, 1), ifnull(prediction_warning.level_score, 1)) = 2 then 84 else 96 end as healthScore, real_warning.latest_avg_temp as avgTemp, prediction_warning.latest_forecast_value as latestForecastValue, case when w.status = 'MAINTENANCE' then 'MAINTENANCE' when greatest(ifnull(real_warning.level_score, 1), ifnull(prediction_warning.level_score, 1)) = 3 then 'WARNING' when greatest(ifnull(real_warning.level_score, 1), ifnull(prediction_warning.level_score, 1)) = 2 then 'ATTENTION' else 'NORMAL' end as riskLevel from warehouse w left join ( select latest_real.warehouse_id, case latest_real.warning_level when 'WARNING' then 3 when 'ATTENTION' then 2 else 1 end as level_score, latest_real.avg_temp as latest_avg_temp from grain_temp_summary latest_real join ( select s2.warehouse_id, max(s2.collected_at) as latest_collected_at from grain_temp_summary s2 join warehouse w2 on w2.id = s2.warehouse_id where w2.status != 'DISABLED'
group by s2.warehouse_id ) latest_summary on latest_summary.warehouse_id = latest_real.warehouse_id and latest_summary.latest_collected_at = latest_real.collected_at ) real_warning on real_warning.warehouse_id = w.id left join ( select pt.warehouse_id, max(case pr.warning_level when 'WARNING' then 3 when 'ATTENTION' then 2 else 1 end) as level_score, max(pr.predicted_value) as latest_forecast_value from prediction_task pt join warehouse w3 on w3.id = pt.warehouse_id left join prediction_result pr on pr.task_id = pt.id and pr.phase_type = 'FUTURE' where w3.status != 'DISABLED'
group by pt.warehouse_id ) prediction_warning on prediction_warning.warehouse_id = w.id where w.status != 'DISABLED'
order by healthScore asc, w.id asc limit 6

select pt.id as taskId, pt.task_no as taskNo, pt.warehouse_id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, pt.risk_level as riskLevel, date_format(pt.requested_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as requestedAt, pt.forecast_days as forecastDays, pt.summary as summary from prediction_task pt join warehouse w on w.id = pt.warehouse_id where w.status != 'DISABLED'
order by pt.requested_at desc, pt.id desc limit 5

select count(*) from ( select * from ( select concat(w.warehouse_name, ' 实时粮温预警') as title, s.warning_level as level, 'REAL' as sourceType, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, date_format(s.collected_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as eventTime, coalesce( s.warning_message, concat('整仓均温 ', s.avg_temp, '°C，最高温 ', s.max_temp, '°C') ) as description from grain_temp_summary s join warehouse w on s.warehouse_id = w.id join ( select warehouse_id, max(collected_at) as latest_collected_at from grain_temp_summary group by warehouse_id ) latest_summary on latest_summary.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id and latest_summary.latest_collected_at = s.collected_at where s.warning_flag = 1
union all
select concat(w.warehouse_name, ' 预测高温预警') as title, pr.warning_level as level, 'PREDICTION' as sourceType, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, date_format(pr.result_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as eventTime, coalesce( pr.warning_message, concat('预测值 ', pr.predicted_value, '°C') ) as description from prediction_result pr join prediction_task pt on pt.id = pr.task_id join warehouse w on pt.warehouse_id = w.id join ( select warehouse_id, max(id) as latest_task_id from prediction_task group by warehouse_id ) latest_task on latest_task.latest_task_id = pt.id where pr.phase_type = 'FUTURE' and pr.warning_flag = 1 ) alert_data
where alert_data.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or alert_data.level like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or alert_data.sourceType like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or alert_data.warehouseName like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or alert_data.eventTime like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or alert_data.description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
) filtered

select * from ( select concat(w.warehouse_name, ' 实时粮温预警') as title, s.warning_level as level, 'REAL' as sourceType, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, date_format(s.collected_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as eventTime, coalesce( s.warning_message, concat('整仓均温 ', s.avg_temp, '°C，最高温 ', s.max_temp, '°C') ) as description from grain_temp_summary s join warehouse w on s.warehouse_id = w.id join ( select warehouse_id, max(collected_at) as latest_collected_at from grain_temp_summary group by warehouse_id ) latest_summary on latest_summary.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id and latest_summary.latest_collected_at = s.collected_at where s.warning_flag = 1
union all

where alert_data.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or alert_data.level like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or alert_data.sourceType like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or alert_data.warehouseName like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or alert_data.eventTime like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or alert_data.description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
